name: Bcrypt Hash Generator
description: Generate bcrypt password hashes with adjustable cost factor. Free, private, runs in your browser.
inputs: Plain text password, cost factor (10, 12, 14), salt rounds
formula: Uses bcryptjs library (loaded inline as a minified blob) to generate a bcrypt hash. Cost factor adjusts computational complexity. Output is a 60-character hash starting with $2a$ or $2b$.

name: Strong Password Generator
description: Generate cryptographically secure passwords. Customize length, character sets, and complexity.
inputs: Password length, include uppercase, include lowercase, include numbers, include symbols, exclude ambiguous characters
formula: Uses crypto.getRandomValues() to generate passwords. Entropy calculation = log2(pool_size) * length. Displays entropy bits and estimated crack time.

name: YAML Formatter & Validator
description: Format, validate, and lint YAML files. Detect syntax errors and convert to JSON.
inputs: YAML input text, indent size (2 or 4 spaces), output format (YAML or JSON)
formula: Parses YAML using js-yaml inline. Validates structure, normalizes indentation, optionally converts to JSON. Reports syntax errors with line numbers.

name: XML Formatter & Beautifier
description: Format, validate, and minify XML. Free, private, runs in your browser.
inputs: XML input text, indent size, action (format, minify, validate)
formula: Uses DOMParser to parse XML, walks the tree, and re-serializes with configurable indentation. Reports parse errors.

name: HTML Entity Encoder / Decoder
description: Encode and decode HTML entities. Convert special characters to safe HTML entities.
inputs: Input text, action (encode or decode), entity type (named or numeric)
formula: Replaces special characters with &, <, >, ", ' for encoding. Decodes using textarea innerHTML trick or hex/dec conversion.

name: Color Picker & Converter
description: Convert colors between HEX, RGB, HSL, and HSV. Includes color preview and palette generator.
inputs: Color input (HEX, RGB, or HSL), target format
formula: Converts between color spaces using standard formulas. HEX to RGB: parse 6-char hex. RGB to HSL: standard algorithm with hue angle. HSL to RGB inverse.

name: Image to Base64 Encoder
description: Convert images to Base64 data URIs. Free, private, runs in your browser.
inputs: Image file upload or drag-and-drop, output format (data URI or raw Base64)
formula: Uses FileReader.readAsDataURL() to encode image as Base64. Displays encoded string and total size. Optional compression via canvas.

name: Markdown to HTML Converter
description: Convert markdown to clean HTML. Live preview, copy output with one click.
inputs: Markdown input, options (GitHub-flavored, line breaks, sanitize)
formula: Parses markdown with a lightweight inline parser. Converts headings, bold, italic, links, code blocks, lists, blockquotes. Outputs sanitized HTML.

name: HTML to Markdown Converter
description: Convert HTML to clean markdown. Strips tags, preserves structure, handles links and images.
inputs: HTML input, options (preserve links, preserve images, bullet style)
formula: Walks the DOM tree, converts h1-h6 to # headers, strong to **, em to *, a to [text](url), ul to -, pre to code blocks.

name: URL Parser & Analyzer
description: Break down any URL into protocol, hostname, path, query params, and fragment.
inputs: URL input
formula: Uses the URL API (new URL()) to parse. Displays each component separately. Query params are decoded and listed individually.

name: HTTP Status Code Lookup
description: Look up any HTTP status code. Full reference of all standard and common codes.
inputs: Status code number or search query, category filter (1xx, 2xx, 3xx, 4xx, 5xx)
formula: Static reference data with descriptions, causes, and examples. Search filters by code or description text.

name: MIME Type Lookup
description: Look up the correct MIME type for any file extension. Complete reference of standard MIME types.
inputs: File extension or MIME type, search query
formula: Static reference map of extensions to MIME types. Reverse lookup also supported. Includes common and uncommon types.

name: Redirect Generator
description: Generate redirect rules for .htaccess, Nginx, Apache, and Cloudflare. Copy-paste ready.
inputs: Source URL, target URL, redirect type (301 or 302), server type (Apache, Nginx, Cloudflare)
formula: Generates syntax-correct redirect rules for the selected server. Apache uses RewriteRule, Nginx uses return directive, Cloudflare uses redirect rules.

name: User-Agent Parser
description: Parse any user-agent string. Identify browser, OS, device type, and version.
inputs: User-agent string
formula: Pattern-matches known browser and OS signatures. Detects Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, and mobile vs desktop. Displays structured output.

name: Cron Expression Builder
description: Build cron expressions visually. Select intervals, preview the schedule in plain English.
inputs: Visual selections (minute, hour, day, month, weekday), output format
formula: Builds cron string from visual selections. Validates against standard cron rules. Human-readable description via pattern matching.

name: Bulk UUID Generator
description: Generate up to 1,000 UUIDs at once. Download as CSV or copy to clipboard.
inputs: Number of UUIDs (1-1000), UUID version (v4 only for browser), output format (plain, CSV, JSON)
formula: Uses crypto.randomUUID() in a loop. Formats output based on selection. CSV format includes an index column.

name: Random Number Generator
description: Generate cryptographically secure random numbers. Customizable range and quantity.
inputs: Minimum value, maximum value, quantity, allow duplicates
formula: Uses crypto.getRandomValues() for cryptographic randomness. Scales to range, optionally removes duplicates for lottery-style picks.

name: Lorem Ipsum Generator
description: Generate lorem ipsum placeholder text. Control paragraphs, sentences, and word count.
inputs: Output type (paragraphs, sentences, words), quantity, start with 'Lorem ipsum'
formula: Static word pool of 50+ Latin words. Randomly assembles sentences and paragraphs based on requested quantity. Always starts with 'Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet'.

name: URL Slug Generator
description: Convert any text into a clean, SEO-friendly URL slug.
inputs: Input text, separator (- or _), lowercase option, remove stop words option
formula: Lowercases, removes special characters, replaces spaces with separator, optionally strips common stop words (a, an, the, and, or, etc).

name: Text Case Converter
description: Convert text between camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case, UPPERCASE, and more.
inputs: Input text, target case (camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, SCREAMING_SNAKE, kebab-case, Title Case, Sentence case, lowercase, UPPERCASE)
formula: Splits input on word boundaries (spaces, camelCase transitions, underscores), then reassembles using the target case rules.
